faq_heading: Questions people ask about AI SEO blog automation

faqs.q: What is AI SEO blog automation?
faqs.a: It is using AI software to run the repeating steps of a blog: choosing buyer keywords, writing answer-first posts, publishing them with internal links, asking Google to index them and tracking results. A person still sets the facts and approves the direction.

faqs.q: Is AI SEO blog automation the same as an AI writing tool?
faqs.a: No. A writing tool produces a draft when you ask. Blog automation also decides the topic, publishes, links, requests indexing and reports, so the work happens without someone starting it each day.

faqs.q: Will Google penalise automated blog posts?
faqs.a: Google says it rewards helpful, reliable content however it is produced, and that using automation mainly to manipulate rankings breaks its spam policy. Posts written from real facts that answer a buyer's question are the safe side of that line.

faqs.q: How many posts should an automated blog publish?
faqs.a: Enough to keep a steady rhythm on topics buyers search for, such as one a day if the topics are good. Quality and fit to buyer questions matter more than raw volume.

faqs.q: Do I need to give my team any work for it?
faqs.a: A little at the start: your approved facts, real examples and the buyers you want. After that, a short weekly check of the numbers is usually enough.
